newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Easier European feeds start week slow.
newsitem.headline: Easier European feeds start week slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started the week slow with sellers offering most products between $2 lower and unchanged following Friday's Chciago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
No trades were reported during the initial stages of the market as a slightly easier but still strong dollar failed to attract early buying interest.
"Mondays are usually slow. A weaker CBOT project A also kept a lid on early business as many dealers anticipate Chicago to ease this afternoon," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
